I am getting old, and my strength is not what it used to be, but I know these lands well. Since this plot is rented and only 0.29 hectares, I will not spend my scarce money on costly chemical fertilizer or sprays that are better saved for land I own. I will use manure from our animals and cuttings I kept from last season's harvest, and rely on the good rains here in the South East to feed my crops. My children and grandchildren will help me with the planting, weeding, and harvesting, but I do not have cash to hire outside labor this season.
